runtimeRules.subject: JWS signature
runtimeRules.proposition: A compact JWT is accepted only when its signature verifies with the supplied key.
runtimeRules.trigger: jwtVerify receives a compact token and key.

runtimeRules.subject: algorithm allowlist
runtimeRules.proposition: When an algorithms allowlist is supplied, a token using an algorithm outside that list is rejected.
runtimeRules.trigger: The protected header algorithm is not in the configured allowlist.

runtimeRules.subject: temporal JWT claims
runtimeRules.proposition: An exp claim at or before the verification time is rejected, and an nbf claim later than the verification time is rejected; exp is not required by default.
runtimeRules.trigger: Verify a token containing exp and/or nbf claims.

applicability.scope: Fixed test time; no clock tolerance.

runtimeRules.subject: issuer and audience policy
runtimeRules.proposition: Configured issuer and audience options require the respective claims and reject mismatched values; an audience array is accepted when it contains the configured audience.
runtimeRules.trigger: Verify a token with issuer and audience options.
